input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

tool_calls:
python3 -c '
from collections import Counter
import re

text = open("/data/poem.txt").read()
# Let us check exact tokens or case
words_raw = text.split()
print("Raw words:", Counter(words_raw).most_common(10))

words_lower = [w.lower() for w in re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)]
print("Lower words:", Counter(words_lower).most_common(10))
'

python3 -c '
from collections import Counter
import re

text = open("/data/poem.txt").read()
words = [w.lower() for w in re.findall(r"\b\w+\b", text)]
for word, count in Counter(words).most_common(3):
    print(f"{word} {count}")
'
